name: @meir-labs/skill-bookmark-triage
description: The meirlabs bookmark-triage skill — turn saved X/Twitter bookmarks into Linear tickets automatically: a daily agent loop that reads new bookmarks via the shiori.sh CLI, classifies each against your idea taxonomy, auto-files the actionable ones, and tags processed links so nothing is double-processed. Includes the hardened headless-run design and the launchd schedule. npx installs it into .claude/skills.
author: Meir Rosenschein
